assetType: portrait mobile game UI texture and decorative control surface
primaryRequest: Create a reusable raster texture sheet for a portrait computer brand management game UI. The game is a realistic 2016 PC workshop: dark powder-coated metal, brushed aluminium, small orange safety markings, compact screws and service labels. Include empty panel plates, a slim status rail, a raised button plate, a recessed toggle plate, a segmented control strip and a progress meter track. These are decorative surfaces only and must not contain readable words, brand logos or invented product names.

inputImages.role: reference image for workshop materials, lighting and orange accent

sceneBackdrop: clean orthographic asset sheet on a neutral transparent or near-black background
styleMedium: realistic industrial product photography translated into a game-ready UI texture sheet
compositionFraming: front-facing, orthographic, each control isolated with generous padding, no perspective distortion
lightingMood: soft workshop light with restrained highlights, readable edges, no neon glow
materialsTextures: powder-coated steel, brushed aluminium, shallow bevels, tiny screws, subtle wear
constraints: keep every control empty and suitable for nine-slice or slicing in Figma; preserve clear silhouettes; no text; no icons; no logos; no watermark
generationStatus: prompt-prepared; built-in image generation tool was unavailable in this session; native Cocos Graphics controls remain the runtime fallback
